prompt: Which query returns every campaign with spend, with its total clicks and its share of its channel's total clicks, as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals, in the columns campaign_id, channel_id, clicks and share_pct? Count all the rows of ad_spend_daily.

options.text:
WITH campaign_clicks AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
)
SELECT campaign_id, channel_id, clicks,
       ROUND(100.0 * clicks / SUM(clicks) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct
FROM campaign_clicks

WITH campaign_clicks AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend

  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
)
SELECT campaign_id, channel_id, clicks,
       ROUND(100.0 * clicks / SUM(clicks) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id), 2) AS share_pct
FROM campaign_clicks
